title: The public 'one prompt' posts: what was in the prompt and around it
naming_rule: creators are identified by post URL only; quote at most one short line; link, never rehost (_critic.md §4.5, §4.6)

posts.headline_claim: made with 'one prompt' using Opus 5.5; about 5 minutes of talking, 12 hours of agent work
inputs_supplied: an MP4 of the earlier video plus its link
the same audio track (a song made by someone else, 2024)
a folder of the creator's references, markdown docs and skills
keys_supplied: 2 API keys referenced in the prompt: one shown in a file (ElevenLabs per web-claims) and a fal key
posts.budget_offered: 'roughly two grand' in fal credits + a Claude Max plan with full usage (Claude Max starts at $100/month, https://claude.com/pricing read 2026-10-03)
requested_only: character sheets from an image model
Seedance 2.5 base clips with the song as reference (the prompt names Seedance 2.5 repeatedly)
a JavaScript redraw over those clips
not_disclosed: whether any Seedance clip ran or survives in the final cut
posts.budget_ratio_offered: about 10:1 to 20:1 generation budget vs agent plan ($2,000 vs $100-200/month) [I]
